stage: journal_cbf_attacker / defender_cbf_v2 (Prompt 5: hierarchical obstacle-vs-defender CBF priority)
motivation: Prompt 4's SHARED-slack joint CBF-QP allowed tactical defender avoidance to trade against physical obstacle safety under severe joint conflict, producing 3/200 obstacle collisions in the Prompt-4 stress set. This stage replaces the shared slack with a strict priority hierarchy: obstacle safety (Priority 1, hard) > velocity limits (Priority 2, hard) > defender avoidance (Priority 3, soft via a dedicated non-negative slack delta_D).

qp_change.old_prompt4: single joint hard QP (obstacle+defender+bounds); on infeasibility, SHARED soft-slack QP relaxing BOTH obstacle and defender constraints via one scalar delta.
qp_change.new_prompt5: Step 1: obstacle+bounds-only hard feasibility check (defender ignored). If infeasible: priority_classification='obstacle_safety_infeasible', fall back to the existing Prompt-2/3 obstacle-only hard->soft->emergency chain (defender dropped entirely, never used to help obstacle safety). If feasible: Step 2a tries obstacle+defender+bounds ALL hard (warm-started from Step 1's solution); if feasible, status='hard'. If Step 2a infeasible (genuine priority conflict): Step 2b solves min 0.5||v-v_nom||^2 + 1e4*delta_D^2 s.t. obstacle hard, defender soft via delta_D>=0, bounds hard; status='soft_fallback' if delta_D>0.
